translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Bita alam kanamsa sung bakayamsa uta ko.
Weng dew kámin kinim so nikil fikal Yuddia bakan teinbidiw so iyo kidilomo Mifiw kinim madik ikil iliso Got weng uyo afan kalebiw ka. Kalesiw.
Kata Bita akal tam Yedusalem una nade kal wakelin ban bosiw kinim Yesus afan kalin iyo Bita weng kanada bom nadiwe
bakodaw, “kaba tam kinim kál wakel luyamongin banim Mifiw im am kal iso imin wanansaw.” Akaniwe,
beta Bita aka adikum sung kana budu utamase uyo kidela dákafi bakoyam,
“naka Yowba abiw dukum kal Got so weng bakanom nadino wisin tem kaokal utamomo lim kal dukum taw kinang kinang alalew so uyo abido kal aluk kudálu madák abu tad bi tad nalam todbi mewso kal abune,
naka lim kal taw tem buwok bo utamomane, adikum bakan dim kámin iniman teng yán alalew so iniman atud so bakan dim faimkun so atim so ade awon el kámin so uyo itaman bom keimine,
beta weng mak bakonam, ‘Bita kan tod nadawe bo abom wanalo!’ Nakune,
naka weng atung fakadu bako, ‘Kamokim bá be. Naka ufek ufek takoyo kalesu uyo naka atin mak kutam bon dádomi banim.’ Kaline,
beta weng abido kal ayo alo bakonam, ‘Got ufek ufek kidel ku bula wanin kuwo. Kalesa uyo kaba bula takoyo kalin bá!’ Nakansu.
Kale weng uyo bakan bi leiw alewbino mo fakadá nadune lim kal dukum taw uyo aluk kutamo asiki abid tikin une kei budune,
beta naka kalomo kinim alewbino mak Sesadiya abiw kalo imadáliw nalam finang tad nalam am teinbi mewso kal tod aliwe,

Sinik Abem ayo bakonam, ‘kaba aket luklakin banim ken luk bala iso unalo!’ Nakane, afan Got afan kalin nikil fikal bokuw kal mak tabiw, iso nikil makuw tad bi tad Sesadiya abiw naduwe tam kinim Koniliyas ami am unuwe,

Koniliyas aka alam wisin utamase umi sung uyo bakoyam, ‘naka nalam am kal tein álino, ensel mak tad am kál misuna nadane bakonam, “Kaba kinim mak imadálaw yak Yowba abiw dukum Saimon finang unino! Saimon alam win mak be Bita.’”
Kale ata weng mak dewyam tadokaba. Kale ami weng dew tad bakoyamokaba uta ta bom kalawso yak adikum kalam am makuw bidiw so kimi ban keimin uyo kail bá takeikuyamokabu ko. Nakeiseno, kalane,
naka Kamok weng uyo kama bakayamono kanam álino, Sinik Abem ayo madák im dim abese. Kale imi kanoyamase be kamakikiw Sinik Abem madák nulum dim abese taw keidane,
naka Kamokim weng bakosa umi finang dási uyo bako kalesa. ‘Yon aka wok tuw wok ban bomin, kinim wanang boyamsa. Kata naka Sinik Abem kiwa imudokabi.’ Kalesa.
Kale be Got ami min gelemin uyo Got afan kalin num kuyamsa taw uyo ikil kano kuyaba namti, naka yaknodin kinimo yak Got ami kukuw kanaba uyo atidawokabi?” Yakane,

ika weng be kidi nadiwade weng tow so bako Bita kanadawongin banim kei nadiwe Got win kufáda bom bako nadiwe, “Got aka Mifiw kinim so imadála ikil iliso aket dumade Got alam sun biyámin uyo kudu sidiwe.” Kalsiw ko.
Antiák abiw Yesus afan kalin mit kei win takuyam Kadisten yakeisiw.

Kale Sitíwen ayo fikalane, im mafak dákanin uyo matam abune, Yesus aket kukádawin kinim iyo basikela yak aba maek aba bom yak Antiák abiw Fonísia bakan abe Saibadas bakan abe kei bom nadiwo weng uyo Yu kayak ita kuw bakayamsiw.

Kata ilim iwyak tem Yesus afan kalin kinim madik ika Saibadas wok gung kinim so Saidin bakan kinim so ikal yak Antiák abiw kal Mifiw kinim iyo Got Weng uyo bakanya bom Kamok Yesus ami sung kidel bakaya bidiwo,
Kamok alam kitid ude kinim iliso tadbu kayo kinim wanang seng seng iyo Kamok Yesus aket kudawsiw.
Kale kinim wanang Kamok Yesus aket kukádawin weng uyo takenom yak Yedusalem kayak Yesus afan kalin kinim dim unu kidi nadiwade ika Bánabas ayo dabadáliw tad Antiák abiw tasa ko.

Aka tad wanang so kinim so iyo itamomane, Got alam min gelemin uyo kudubiw ka. Kale nadanade aka kalfalin dukum kuw kudu nadano wanang kinim iyo aket wis sánya bom bakoyam, “kiba kim aket uyo adikum atin afan kale Kamok kudaw yak alami mewso ki biyámino.” Kale Bánabas weng yakeisa.
Bánabas aka atin kinim kidel aka Sinik Abem weina dausa kinim ade afan kalin kinim kayo kinim wanang seng iyo imadew maek dáda Kamok ami kinim wanang keisiw ko.
Yanol beta kawák Bánabas ayo Tásas abiw kal Saul fenon kale unsa.

Kale aka yak Saul fen kámom atami ka. Kale nadanade ayo faksiki Saul dew tad Antiák abiw tasa. Kale Bánabas so Saul so iyo alew itol makuw um dim kal Got ami kinim wanang gu so teina bom nadiw Got weng uyo kinim wanang seng kukuya bom keimsiw. Kale Antiák abiw kawákal mit kei Yesus ibik tein kámin kinim iyo win takuyam, “Kadisten” yaksiw ka.
Kanamsiw atan kawákal lum senin kinim madik iyo Yedusalem kalo tad Antiák tasiw ko.

Lum senin kinim makuw am win Akabas ayo Sinik Abem kitid dim matam tod weng bako, “imin wol fut dukum mak tadokabu uyo matam abe adikum Udom bakan mak mak tadokabu ko.” Kalesa. Kale be Kaláddias ata matam kamok kei nada bakan bula kin mo badano, imin wolfut uyo matam abesu.
Kale Yesus ibik tein kámin kinim ikil kanamin bo matam bune ilim nikil fikal Yuddia bakan teinbidiw iyo dakoyamumo. Kale nikil kisol seng kuw kutida kutida yumo. Kale nadiwe
afan kisol kudew tada tada aú nadiwe Bánabas so Saul so imi dim kudáliw Yuddia Yesus afan kalin gu gebom im dim unsu ko.
